verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair question for a voice-AI framework with a hosted cloud, so the axis applies. The pack documents no retention policy, deletion API, or retention setting for Pipecat or Pipecat Cloud. Audio recording and transcript capture are developer building blocks, and self-hosting or local inference are user-side arrangements, so none of them count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
